import importlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl
from polars.testing import assert_frame_equal
from ibex_polars import IbexEngine

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark')
data = Path('/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark/data/tables/scale-10.0')
query = importlib.import_module('queries.polars.q15').q(
    **{path.stem: pl.scan_parquet(path) for path in data.glob('*.parquet')})
engine = IbexEngine().prepare(query)
Path('/tmp/q15-source.ibex').write_text(engine.explain(query))
result = query.collect(engine=engine)
assert_frame_equal(result, query.collect(engine='streaming'), rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-8)
print(result.to_dicts())
